summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of PAZER (Phase 1-3). Wrote pytest suite with 21 tests across auth/wallet/fixed-game/rooms/admin — all pass after 1 test-side fix (email lowercased). Ran full Playwright E2E covering register → dashboard → wallet deposit (verified 1000 + 100 bonus = 1,100 total) → fixed challenge full flow → rooms list/join → admin login → admin config save → admin users tab. Everything works end-to-end.

issues: /api/auth/me is called on public pages (login, register, home) when no token is present, producing 401 console errors. Cosmetic but noisy — main agent could suppress the call when no token exists in localStorage/cookies.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In AuthContext, skip GET /api/auth/me when no localStorage token exists to eliminate benign 401 console noise on public pages.
OPTIONAL: Route inconsistency — the request mentioned /play/fixed but actual route is /play (App.js). Consider aliasing /play/fixed to /play for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1075 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting auth/wallet/games/rooms/admin into separate routers for maintainability.
credit_wallet reads user via get_user_by_id but then uses stale user in successive calls in fixed_stop; low risk since await guarantees fresh reads.
Room finalize_room ignores flagged submissions but still includes them in participants list; correct behavior but could log flagged players.
Anti-cheat LATENCY_BOUND=2.5s is generous; may allow small cheat window in slow networks. Acceptable per spec.
CORS uses env CORS_ORIGINS with default '*' plus allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject '*'+credentials. In prod ensure CORS_ORIGINS is set to explicit origins.
seed_admin correctly updates existing admin password if changed (compliant with playbook).
test_credentials: Admin admin@pazer.com / Admin@123 works. Test users created via POST /api/auth/register (TEST_/ui_ prefix).
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed users via registration during tests; kept for potential regression. Auto-created rooms verified (6 OPEN rooms present).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 21 pytest cases covering auth (incl. admin RBAC + lockout not exercised), wallet deposit+bonus+txn ledger, fixed game full win/replay/concurrent/anti-cheat flag, rooms list/join/double-join, admin config/users/kyc/withdraw approve+reject/suspend+reactivate/stats/audit. Frontend routes: /register /login /dashboard /wallet /play (NOT /play/fixed) /rooms /admin. All key data-testids present and working.
